verdict.rationale: Foreloop is a SaaS workflow platform, so outbound event webhooks are a fair axis. The evidence never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Instead, agents poll for approved tasks 'on a cadence', and the other integration surfaces (MCP endpoint, CLI with --json, GitHub checks and comments) are adjacent features that do not deliver webhook subscriptions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
